# Waymark 0.2.6

- Pet portraits and observed ownership/level colors on the main map and minimap. Includes 385 general farming-area references across Verteron and Altgard, covering 146 pets. Selecting an area outlines its region; these are not exact monster spawns.
- Dedicated Pets page with portrait cards, visible locations and level milestones. Saved icon-based sorting cycles through closest unfinished pets, undiscovered first and alphabetical order. Completed and unobserved pets remain distinct.
- Pet-specific map filtering, optional Lv 3 visibility and links from the pet catalog to farming areas. The catalog is available before a login observation; missing ownership remains unknown.
- Full app backup/restore with native file dialogs, a restore preview, integrity checks and an automatic recovery backup. Includes observed pets/completion history and saved settings alongside planning data. Restores restart Waymark. Legacy planning JSON remains supported.
- Prevent the passive reader from restarting during restore/update handoff.

Existing data is retained. Raw recordings and signing keys are never included in app backups or releases. Automatic collection, precise Npcap movement, live inventory/resources, dungeon/stronghold completion and live Abyss/Timespace validation remain unfinished. No new gameplay testing is claimed.

Install through Waymark's update notice or run **Waymark-0.2.6-Setup.exe**. Downloads show percentage progress; installation restarts the app. Users still on 0.2.4 need Setup once to obtain the in-app updater.
